metadata.act_name: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Act No. 1 of 2010)
metadata.enforcing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs (DoCA), Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Declaration of Name and Address of Manufacturer, Packer, or Importer
rules.statutory_text: Every package shall bear thereon the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and complete address of the manufacturer and the packer, or in case of an imported package, the name and complete address of the importer.

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Failure to declare the complete name and geographical address of the manufacturer/packer/importer on the principal display panel in violation of Rule 6(1)(a).

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Declaration of Common or Generic Name of the Commodity
rules.statutory_text: Every package shall bear thereon the common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product.

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Absence of clear common or generic name of the pre-packaged commodity as required under Rule 6(1)(b).

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Declaration of Net Quantity in Standard Units of Weight, Measure or Number
rules.statutory_text: Every package shall bear thereon the net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned.

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Net quantity not expressed in correct standard legal metrology SI units or symbols pursuant to Rule 6(1)(c) and Rule 11.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Declaration of Month and Year of Manufacture / Packaging / Pre-packing
rules.statutory_text: Every package shall bear thereon the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Missing or ambiguous date of manufacture/packing or use-by duration on the package in contravention of Rule 6(1)(d).

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Declaration of Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Inclusive of All Taxes and Unit Sale Price
rules.statutory_text: Every package shall bear thereon the retail sale price of the package in the form 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price Rs. ...... or ₹ ...... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs. / ₹ ...... incl. of all taxes', with the unit sale price declared where applicable.

legal_consequences.act_section: Section 36(1) read with Section 18(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) not declared with the statutory mandatory 'inclusive of all taxes' expression or declared in misleading format under Rule 6(1)(e).

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Consumer Care Details for Grievance Redressal
rules.statutory_text: Every package shall bear thereon the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints.

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Failure to provide mandatory consumer grievance redressal contact details (valid telephone/toll-free number and email address) on package under Rule 6(1)(h).

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Declaration of Country of Origin on Imported Packages
rules.statutory_text: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package.

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Absence of clear Declaration of Country of Origin on imported packaged commodity under Rule 6(1)(aa).

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Principal Display Panel (PDP) and Minimum Font Height Specifications
rules.statutory_text: Every declaration shall be prominent, legible and unambiguous. The minimum height of numerals and letters based on net quantity or area of Principal Display Panel shall conform to Table I and Table II.

validation_criteria.contrast_requirement: Letters and numerals must be in distinct contrast with the background

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Mandatory declarations printed below the statutory minimum font size or lacking required background contrast under Rule 7 and Rule 9.

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Prohibition of Sale Above Maximum Retail Price (Dual MRP / Overcharging)
rules.statutory_text: No person shall sell or deliver to any person, or permit sale of any pre-packaged commodity at a price higher than the retail sale price declared on the package, or display dual Maximum Retail Prices on identical commodities.

legal_consequences.act_section: Section 36(2) and Section 18(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Charging above Maximum Retail Price (MRP) or pasting altered price stickers on pre-packaged goods in violation of Rule 18(1).

rules.chapter: Chapter II — Provisions Applicable to Packages Intended for Retail Sale
rules.rule_title: Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) in Net Quantity Determination
rules.statutory_text: The maximum permissible error, in excess or in deficiency, in the net quantity by weight or by volume of any commodity shall be as specified in the Second Schedule.

legal_consequences.act_section: Section 30 read with Section 36 of Legal Metrology Act, 2009

penalty_structure.subsequent_offences: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year, or both

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Net commodity contents found deficient beyond Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) thresholds specified in Schedule II.

rules.rule_title: EAN/UPC Barcode Cross-Verification with Open Food Facts Database
rules.statutory_text: Validation of declared manufacturer identity against official GS1/Open Food Facts global and national barcode registry records to eliminate ghost manufacturers and counterfeit packaging.

penalty_structure.first_offence: Immediate seizure of counterfeit/unregistered batch + Legal Notice

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Discrepancy detected between scanned GTIN barcode registration and declared manufacturer on physical packaging.

rules.rule_title: Visual Feature Anomaly and Tampered Declaration Detection
rules.statutory_text: Forensic validation of label typography, overprinting, erased markings, price smudges, or re-stickered retail packaging.

penalty_structure.first_offence: Fine up to ₹25,000 + confiscation of tampered packages

legal_consequences.default_notice_clause: Mandatory declarations appear physically tampered, smudged, or re-labeled in violation of Legal Metrology packaging integrity standards.
